TODO

Source: TODO.md

Findings from the code review of R/ (2026-11-06). Ordered by priority. None of these are blocking.

1. Add edfct to the NEC models (feature gap: ED() stops on NEC.2/3/4)

NEC() in R/nec.R sets edfct <- NULL, so ED(nec_fit, ...) fails with “ED values cannot be calculated for this model”.

Model: f(x) = c + (d - c) * exp(-b * (x - e) * I(x > e)), i.e. the response is flat until e, then decays.

  • In NEC() define (parameters b, c, d, e; follow the llogistic() pattern with parmVec[notFixed] <- parm):

    edfct <- function(parm, respl, reference, type, ...)
{
    parmVec[notFixed] <- parm
    p <- absToRel(parmVec, respl, type)      # percent effect, 0-100
    EDp <- parmVec[4] - log(1 - p/100) / parmVec[1]
    EDder <- c( log(1 - p/100) / parmVec[1]^2,   # d/db
                0, 0,                            # d/dc, d/dd (relative type)
                1 )                              # d/de
    list(EDp, EDder[notFixed])
}

  • Only valid for decreasing curves with b > 0. Return list(NA, rep(NA, sum(notFixed))) if b <= 0 or p is outside (0, 100).

  • type = "absolute": ED.drc already replaces the gradient with a numerical central-difference one, so no extra work is needed.

  • Add the edfct = edfct entry to the returned list.

  • Tests (tests/testthat/test-nec.R): fit NEC.4() on ryegrass, check ED(m, 50) equals e - log(0.5)/b from coef(m); check the standard error is finite; check type = "absolute" runs.

  • Update AGENTS.md (remove “NEC models have NO edfct”) and vignettes/nec-models.Rmd if it says ED is unavailable.

  • Note: the NEC itself is already the parameter e; EDx is the dose at x% reduction beyond it.

2. Decide on drmEMstandard (dead code)

R/drmEMstandard.R is not reachable from drm() because type only accepts continuous, binomial, Poisson, negbin1, negbin2, event, ssd. It is only exercised by tests/testthat/test-drmEMstandard.R.

Pick one: - Remove: delete R/drmEMstandard.R, tests/testthat/test-drmEMstandard.R, and the "standard" branch in vcov.drc() (contData check). Run devtools::test(). - Keep: add "standard" to the type choices in drm() and drm_legacy(), add a dispatch branch next to the other drmEM* calls in drm(), and document the option in @param type.

3. Make getMeanFunctions() complete (documentation inconsistency)

R/getMeanFunctions.R lists only LL, W1, W2, BC, LL2, AR, MM. The README advertises 40+ models.

  • Extend the default fctList with G.2/3/3u/4, LN.2/3/3u/4, L.3/4/5, W1.3u, W2.3u, EXD.2/3, CRS.4a-c, CRS.5a-c, CRS.6, UCRS.4a-c, UCRS.5a-c, NEC.2/3/4, FPL.4, W2x.3/4, baro5, gammadr.
  • Check each constructor works with its defaults (some, e.g. FPL.4, need arguments; skip or pass them).
  • Check test-getMeanFunctions.R still passes; its expected counts will change.

4. Decide whether mrdrm() and NEC() should be exported (API decision)

  • mrdrm() is not exported, but its S3 methods (plot, predict, print, ED for mrdrc) are registered. Users cannot reach them without drc:::; tests already use drc:::mrdrm.
    • To export: add mrdrm to the export() list in NAMESPACE, make sure man/mrdrm.Rd exists with an example, add it to _pkgdown.yml.
    • To keep internal: remove the S3 registrations or leave as is, and state it in the docs.
  • NEC() (base constructor) is not exported while NEC.2/3/4 are. Only change if users need custom fixed patterns; otherwise leave.

5. Guard against NAMESPACE drift (process, not a bug)

NAMESPACE is hand-maintained (no roxygen header), so @export tags are ignored by devtools::document() for it.

  • Whenever you add an exported function or S3 method, edit NAMESPACE by hand in the same commit.
  • Before each release run devtools::check() and look for “Undocumented code objects” and “S3 methods not registered” notes.
  • Optional: add a test that compares getNamespaceExports("drc") to a stored list so unintended export changes fail CI.
